core_aesthetic_takeaways: The batch is valuable for training quiet luxury in packaging: one clear product or logo anchor, restrained palette, and strong negative space.
The strongest transferable feature is the relationship between matte white product bodies, warm bamboo lids, red or charcoal vertical labels, dark textured boxes, and metallic gold foil.
The system layout image is useful for teaching ordered VI packaging presentation without visual clutter.
The macro images are useful as material references for foil stamping and textured substrate, but should be weighted lower for global composition training.
prompt_structure_lessons: Start prompts with product category and design domain, then lock object count and view type.
Describe the visual anchor before material detail.
Separate exact text requirements from texture-like microcopy.
Use explicit negative constraints against extra props, decorative landscapes, random ornaments, background noise, and pseudo-Chinese typography.
For macro material prompts, state that shallow depth of field is intentional and should not imply cropped product mistakes in hero views.

text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use this batch for visual hierarchy, label placement, foil material, and brand-system order. Do not train exact Chinese body copy unless vector/OCR ground truth is added.

risk_controls.mitigation: caption dense copy as microcopy risk, add exact text source before text-positive training, and avoid using this batch as the only typography dataset.
separate material texture labels from pale background grain; downweight background texture during crop selection.
tag brand mark as abstract logo scale and placement; do not use it as a universal mark shape.

risk_controls.risk: macro crop leakage into hero renders
risk_controls.mitigation: separate view_type labels for hero, system layout, and macro material study.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: include as high-quality positive case batch after rights review
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: use captions to teach premium packaging hierarchy and anti-fragmentation rules
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: train only after adding more tea/food packaging cases and exact text ground truth where typography precision matters

negative_prompt_atoms: messy tea leaves scattered around the product
dirty gray noise as a main style
